verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec for its entity or filing data, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: both scc.virginia.gov and cis.scc.virginia.gov disallow all crawling, and neither host was fetched further. Nothing in the pack shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Confidence is low because the lack of evidence comes from the sites never being explored, not from confirming that no spec exists.
